headline: Espace Ambroise Croizat / TAUTEM Architecture
context: Between the Arceaux and Figuerolles districts, TAUTEM transforms the Center for Social Experimentation and Innovation (CEIS) into an architecture of care and dignity, attentive to the Mediterranean climate and to the memory of the site.
